summary: Round 3 verification of Fleet Enquiry form, Weekly Cashback History log, and Giveaway countdown urgency styling. Backend: extended backend_test.py from 31 -> 41 tests, all 41 passing. New coverage: TestFleetEnquiry (7 tests: success, mongo persistence, 422 on missing name/email/message, empty name, invalid email) and TestCashbackHistory (3 tests: 401 unauth, empty list for new user, populated list after Private-tier auto-grant with tier+percent meta and no _id leak). Frontend UI: (a) giveaway-countdown ticks visibly (17d 15h 36m 02s -> 01s across 1.5s), no 'DRAWING NOW' state, urgent flicker only in final 24h (not forced this run, code path verified). (b) /fleet-sales form submits with all 5 fields and shows fleet-success. (c) /wallet cashback log verified end-to-end: registered fresh user, seeded Mongo to Private tier + net loss + last_cashback_at=null, /auth/me auto-granted +10 credits (cashback_just_paid=10, balance 10000->10010), GET /api/cashback/history returned 1 row {type:'cashback', amount:10, meta:{tier:'Private',percent:1}}, no mongo _id, and Wallet page rendered 'WEEKLY CASHBACK HISTORY' section with 'PRIVATE CASHBACK · 1%' row +10. Regression: no 'War of Wages' typo on landing/fleet-sales/wallet; register/login/me/slots list/payments/leaderboard/vip/keno/coinflip/bonus/cashback status+claim all pass in pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 824 lines (past 700 threshold) — split fleet/cashback/payments into routers.
GET /api/cashback/history is limited to .to_list(50) with no pagination — fine now but add ?limit/?before for growth.
grant_cashback still races with /cashback/claim on last_cashback_at (noted iter 2). Consider $currentDate + conditional filter on last_cashback_at to make grant atomic.
Fleet enquiry endpoint has no auth and no rate limit — spammable in production. Recommend adding IP rate limit or captcha.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (fleet form, wallet cashback log, giveaway countdown)

test_credentials: Admin admin@wagesofwarcasino.com / WagesOfWar2025! (verified). Ephemeral test users registered per run via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: TestCashback.test_cashback_private_tier_payout and TestCashbackHistory.test_history_after_payout each register a fresh user and directly update MongoDB to set total_wagered=6000, total_won=5000, cashback_wagered_snapshot=0, cashback_won_snapshot=0, last_cashback_at=null to reach Private tier and reopen the cashback window. Fleet enquiry tests insert TEST_-prefixed documents into fleet_enquiries collection (not cleaned up — safe: play-money only, prefix-tagged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 41 tests. New classes: TestFleetEnquiry, TestCashbackHistory. Countdown is now rolling 30-day cycle anchored to Jan 2, 2026 20:00 UTC so it shows ~17 days remaining and ticks every second — matches spec. Wallet cashback log only renders when cashbackLog.length > 0; use the mongo prep in TestCashbackHistory.test_history_after_payout to reproduce. Fleet enquiry POST /api/fleet/enquiry is unauthenticated and returns {ok:true,id}. cashback transaction row shape: {id, user_id, type:'cashback', amount, meta:{tier,percent}, created_at} — Wallet.jsx reads c.meta?.tier and c.meta?.percent.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 3 features work as specified. Only failure observed was in my initial Playwright script (mongo prep subprocess had bad indentation causing prep to no-op, which made cashback_just_paid=None and history=empty). Fixed by writing the prep script to /tmp/prep_cb.py properly indented; on retry, auto-grant fired, history returned 1 row, and wallet log rendered with 'PRIVATE CASHBACK · 1%' +10 as expected.
